01 / OVERVIEW

Community events platform

Bandhan is built around small, practical ways to help a community. Visitors can explore local events across causes such as plantation, education, food and health. Members can organise gatherings, join events and manage their own contributions.

TECHNOLOGY STACK
Next.jsReactJavaScriptTailwind CSSBetterAuthMongoDB
02 / FEATURESWHAT THE APPLICATION DOES

Features

01

Browse upcoming events by cause and search by location or title.

02

Create and manage events with photos, dates and locations.

03

Sign in with Google or email, and keep joined events in one place.

04

Switch between light and dark themes with a saved preference.

03 / DEVELOPMENTIMPLEMENTATION DETAILS

Challenges & decisions

01

Authentication across two services

The Next.js client connects to a separate Express API. A same-origin proxy keeps client requests and session cookies consistent, while the API checks sessions and event ownership.

02

Clear event rules

Event dates must be in the future, repeat joins should not create extra participation records, and organisers should only manage their own events. Validation and ownership checks support these rules.

03

Useful feedback at every step

Uploads, empty event lists and slow API responses need understandable feedback. The interface includes loading skeletons, image fallbacks, retries and empty states.
